text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Still, you're seriously good at this. 
What do you even eat to get so good at 
drawing?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If only I were as good as Marche-chan, 
maybe I'd have made a name for myself as a 
young prodigy by now."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Aha! I got praised☆"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"B-But wait, this is still just a rough 
sketch☆ Next, I'll clean up the lines~ and 
color it in~"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I really oughtta learn from that 
patience of hers.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Marche-chan. If you're gonna keep 
drawing, do ya mind if I watch too?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'll treat ya to some juice as a snack. 
Sounds good, right?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Marche-cha—... huh?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "‘L-Like I said! I am so, so sorry!’"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Marche-chan? And who 
might this be...?

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! Who the hell are you?! You with this 
guy?

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm pissed off after getting bumped into 
out of nowhere. Why don't you bow your 
head along with them?!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"L-La-san had nothing to do with it! And 
besides, I wasn't the one who bumped 
into—"

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't tell me you're blaming this on 
me! This is why I can't stand you Tracen 
folks—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, no need to get so worked up. 
Doesn't matter whose fault it was, can't 
we just call it even with a quick "my bad" 
and "sorry"?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right? Look, I'll even bow my head like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"No, that won't do. If you're going to 
apologize, you'll have to show some proper 
sincerity."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Sincerity, is it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I see. So we're settling this with 
a freestyle race, then?

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well, for folks like you who've only ever 
run clean races, this match might be at a 
bit of a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well now— who knows about that?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Uu... Lara-san, are you alright? If it's 
running, I could—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sure, sure, Marche-chan. Could you wait 
just a moment for me?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I'll finish this up real quick.

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —...gh, dammit!! Dammit allll!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Damn it, this is our home turf... so why?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If you're still not satisfied, please feel 
free to reach out to me again anytime.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The name's Lucky Lilac. Whenever you 
call, I'll be there to take you on."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while standing around chatting 
with Lucky Lilac—

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"La-san!! Thank you so, so much for 
yesterday!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's really no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Seems like there was some sort of 
misunderstanding. I just stepped in 
between 'em to talk it out.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "La-san was so dependable☆ I... I wanna—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be like Lara-san, so even when 
I'm scared, I won't give up, and I can try 
my best――!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're exaggerating. Marche-chan, I 
think staying just the way you are is just 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Ho.

text_block_list.name: Lara & Marche
text_block_list.text: Huh, O-Orfe-san?! "Hwah, Orfe-san?!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah... was I in your way? I'm so sorry, 
I'll move right away—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well. —Continue to work diligently 
henceforth.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wh-What? What was that all 
about...?
choice_data_list: You were praising me, weren't you?
She told us to "work hard," didn't she...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san... wants me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quietly watched over Lucky Lilac as she 
fell into a contemplative silence.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I don't quite get it, but that's the gist 
of it, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Orfe-san took the trouble to tell 
me that, so I've gotta work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's get right into trainin'! I'm in a 
proper mood for a good run right now!
